subject: Quick Qs before demo: traffic slices, peak windows, and sandbox access
messages:
From: Aisha Morales <aisha@cartly.io>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2027-12-08T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick Qs before demo: traffic slices, peak windows, and sandbox access

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the invite — Tom and I signed up through the self-serve flow and would love a short walkthrough before we commit to a pilot. A few quick things so the demo can be tailored: 

- Our daily traffic is bursty: 3M requests/day on weekdays but spikes to ~18M on promo days. Is that a profile you can simulate?
- For peak windows, we have two main periods: 08:00–11:00 PST and 18:00–21:00 PST. Can the demo show latency under those slices?
- We’d like to test embeddings for search (small index, ~1.2M vectors) — what sample data shape should we send?
- Do you provide a sandbox with our data retention settings/SSO, or is that part of Dedicated?

Attaching a quick traffic CSV and our SSO checklist. Proposed times: Tue 12/14 10:00 PST, Wed 12/15 15:00 PST (30 min). Either works for us.

Cheers,
Aisha Morales
Head of ML Ops, Cartly
Aisha.m@cartly.io

Attachments: traffic_profile_sample.csv (csv, 12KB), sso-requirements.pdf (pdf, 48KB)

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Aisha Morales <aisha@cartly.io>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-12-08T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Qs before demo: traffic slices, peak windows, and sandbox access

Hi Aisha — great context, thanks. I looped Monica (solutions engineer) to surface the right parts of the demo. Quick answers inline below and a short pre-demo checklist so we don’t waste time: 

- Burst profile: we can replay a traffic slice that mimics weekday baseline vs promo spikes; please indicate whether the 18M spikes are sustained for minutes or hours. For the demo we typically run a 15-minute stress slice at peak QPS.
- Peak windows: yes—Monica can set up two parallel load scenarios to show latency/percentile differences. We’ll highlight 50/ p95/ p99.
- Embeddings: 1.2M vectors is a useful scale. For demo, a 50k sample of representative vectors works; include dimensionality and whether you’re using cosine or dot-product for similarity.
- Sandbox & SSO: we can provision a time-limited sandbox in our hosted environment with optional SSO simulation (SAML mock) for the demo. Full Dedicated/VPC is a separate procurement path.

Proposed next steps:
1) If you can drop a one-page traffic summary (start/end times for spikes + duration) we’ll create the load script.
2) Pick one of the times below — I blocked both in Calendly if you prefer quick booking: https://cal.com/rafael_mendes/cartly-demo?slot=30

Tue 2027-12-14 10:00 PST (30m)
Wed 2027-12-15 15:00 PST (30m)

Monica will follow up on the technical checklist. Looking forward — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
(415) 555-0147

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Aisha Morales <aisha@cartly.io>, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2027-12-08T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Qs before demo: traffic slices, peak windows, and sandbox access

Hi Aisha — quick technical checklist so we can prepare the demo environment: 

1) Traffic CSV: please include timestamp, QPS estimate, request type (generate/embed/rerank), and whether payloads include long prompts (>2k tokens).
2) Embeddings: tell us vector dimensionality, index type (Faiss/HNSW), and whether you intend to compress/quantize. If you don’t know, default to 768 dims, cosine.
3) Sample dataset: upload a 50k sample (CSV or ndjson) to the HubSpot record or share a Drive link; we can pull securely.
4) SSO: if you want a SAML simulation, provide IdP metadata or we’ll use a mock for the demo — no live SSO will be configured without an enterprise agreement.
5) Goals: what would make the demo a success? E.g., p95 < 350ms on baseline, embedding recall target, cost-per-1k-requests target.

I can also run a quick pre-demo smoke test with a 5-minute replay once we have the traffic CSV. If you confirm Wed 12/15 15:00 PST, I’ll reserve a dedicated cluster for that slot.

Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachments requested: traffic_profile_sample.csv (preferred), sample_vectors_50k.ndjson (optional)

From: Aisha Morales <aisha@cartly.io>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Kline <tom.k@cartly.io>
Date: 2027-12-09T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick Qs before demo: traffic slices, peak windows, and sandbox access

Thanks Rafael/Monica — appreciate the checklist. Attached is an updated traffic CSV (columns as requested) and a 50k sample vectors ndjson (sideload link).

Quick clarifications: the 18M spikes are typical of promo days and last ~3–4 hours; the 3M baseline is steady. For embeddings we use 512 dims, dot-product. Success criteria: p95 < 400ms on baseline and embedding recall > 0.86 on our sample queries.

Wed 2027-12-15 15:00 PST works for us — Tom will join. We’ll accept the Calendly invite.

See you then,
Aisha

Attachments: traffic_profile_sample_v2.csv (csv, 22KB), sample_vectors_50k.ndjson (ndjson, 6MB)
